title: Synthetic contact with AI reduces cross-partisan animosity
discussion_signal: The research announcement frames AI-mediated interaction as a possible form of intergroup contact that can reduce cross-partisan animosity. It creates a counter-signal to simple polarization narratives while raising questions about whether simulated contact transfers to durable human cooperation.
linked_research_question: Can AI-mediated synthetic contact reduce political hostility, and does any effect carry into human civic relationships and collective action?
limits: Research announcement rather than full paper review
No effect sizes or design details are visible in the post
A short-term attitude shift may not become durable political cooperation
